paper_context.public_release_scope: Structured JSON result release for manual expert extraction, semantic merge review, final delivery audit, and expert agreement review. Expert identities, local files, and non-public operational metadata are excluded.

review_statement: This file reports the manual expert semantic agreement review summary. The review source is manual expert review.

manual_review_declaration.decision_basis: expert inspection, expert scoring, expert semantic merge, and expert final delivery audit
manual_review_declaration.expert_reviewer_profile_scope: anonymous education level and professional experience years only

expert_reviewer_profile_note: Reviewer identities, affiliations, and personal identifiers are not disclosed. The public profile records only education level and professional experience years provided for the manual expert agreement review.
sample_records_note: The companion file provides the anonymized 60 sampled item-level semantic agreement records used to support the agreement summary.

semantic_review_scope.review_purpose: agreement analysis for semantic review criteria
semantic_review_scope.category_interpretation: Public item-level category codes describe clear semantic alignment versus semantic-boundary alignment. They are not acceptance/rejection labels and are not a second final-delivery acceptance decision.
semantic_review_scope.disagreement_interpretation: Disagreements indicate different expert classification of semantic-boundary cases, especially for UCA semantics, rather than a final-delivery exclusion decision.
